title: Great “Hold” Feature, But Falls Short on “Instant Read”
text:
Great “Hold” Feature, But Falls Short on “Instant Read”. This BEYOND GROUP 1 33 DIGITAL INSTANT READ THERMOCOUPLE THERMOMETER (with Folding Probe) has one great feature--a “Hold” button that locks the reading so you can read it after you remove the probe. However, it is NOT an “instant read” thermometer--when your fingers heat the probe a little by unfolding it, the display is very slow to return to a room temperature reading. Also, It takes many seconds to reach a stable reading after the probe is inserted into hot food.

The thermometer gives readings that are a couple of degrees higher than my expensive [[ASIN:B01M6V1SXE Thermapen]] (which does give instant readings). You’ll want to test this thermometer in boiling water, to determine what the degree readings really mean, if you’re planning to use it to test cooked meats for safety.

The default display shows Centigrade numbers; if you want Fahrenheit, you must press the “Hold” button for 3 seconds. You must reset to Fahrenheit frequently--whenever you power on the thermometer, and whenever it shuts off automatically (after a fairly short time).

The “Hold” button works as promised. When the temperature is locked, the display shows the last reading. (The display blinks when it’s reading temperatures.) However, the “Hold” feature isn’t enough to overcome the thermometer’s other deficiencies.
